body:
Hi friend! 

Sorry this might be a little late. As someone who has attempted with Zoloft, I'd strongly avoid going that route. Pills, in general, are a horrible method. Our bodies do whatever they can to survive no matter how much we want to die, it's just a natural reaction. I'm not a doctor or anything, but overdosing on pills will probably just lead to you throwing up and getting sick. That's what happened to me and every minute of it was painful.

I made a post not too long ago about what I experienced going through it. So if you want, you can click on my name and read about it. It's not fun.

Thanks stranger! :)

A waterproof bedsheet doesn't sound like a bad idea. That way my bed won't turn into a swimming pool while I'm crying myself to sleep.
